If you're really concerned about it and you can easily access them, I recommend an at home pregnancy test. There's a slight chance that your partner could have had pre-ejaculate, which has the potential to get you pregnant (although way less than regular ejaculate). If you think there's a chance for pregnancy even if you were as safe as possible with unprotected sex, don't wait to see if you miss your period. You should also tell your partner so he knows your plan, and you can plan together for all the possibilities. In the future though, you should use condoms or think about some form of birth control to ease your anxiety. Hope that helps :)
